purpose: Identity anchor reused for every exercise video. Same person, same clothes, every time.

output.style: photorealistic studio photography, natural skin texture, not illustrated, not CGI-looking

character.identity: a fit adult woman in her early 30s, athletic but not bodybuilder build, medium height, light olive skin, dark brown hair tied in a low bun, calm focused neutral expression, no tattoos, no jewelry, no visible makeup

wardrobe.top: fitted plain charcoal grey short-sleeve t-shirt, no logos
wardrobe.bottom: plain matte black knee-length training shorts, no logos
wardrobe.left_wrist: TEAL (#4a8894) terry-cloth wristband on the LEFT wrist only
wardrobe.right_wrist: MUTED PURPLE (#a279a8) terry-cloth wristband on the RIGHT wrist only
wardrobe.left_foot: TEAL (#4a8894) ankle sock on the LEFT foot only
wardrobe.right_foot: MUTED PURPLE (#a279a8) ankle sock on the RIGHT foot only

layout: four views side by side on one sheet: front view standing, left side view standing, back view standing, right side view standing; plus one head-and-shoulders close-up in the top-right corner
pose: relaxed neutral standing, arms slightly away from the body so both wristbands are clearly visible, feet hip-width so both socks are visible
environment: seamless matte charcoal studio background (#16181c), dark grey matte floor (#24272f), no props, no text, no labels
lighting: soft even key light from front-above, gentle rim light separating the silhouette from the dark background, no harsh shadows
must: teal items are ONLY on the person's LEFT side, purple items ONLY on the RIGHT side, in every view
identical person, face and clothing across all views
